settings.question: Why do you charge 99p?
settings.answer: The sachets are free. 99p covers Royal Mail postage so we can send a Hot and Ice sachet to your door.

settings.question: Can I order more than one pack?
settings.answer: One pack per household. That keeps the offer fair and stops wholesale orders of free samples.

settings.question: Can I use it alongside other products?
settings.answer: Yes. HEMPE gels are cosmetics. Follow the directions on the sachet and speak to a healthcare professional if you are unsure.

settings.heading: Try both. Just 99p postage.
settings.subheading: Get one Hot gel sachet and one Ice gel sachet for free. You just cover the 99p postage.
settings.accordion_usage:
• Apply 3-4 times a day and massage until absorbed by skin
  • Do not swallow
  • Avoid contact with eyes
  • Wash hands after use
  • If pregnant, always consult your doctor before considering use of any new topical skincare solution
settings.accordion_storage:
• Protect from sunlight
  • Store in a cool, dry place
  • Keep out of reach of children
  • Test on a small area of the skin before full application
